Iron fortification of staple food is a strategy utilized worldwide to address the concern of dietary iron deficiency. However, traditional salt-based fortification methods have limitations with gastrointestinal stability and bioavailability. Iron chelating peptides from easily available and scalable …
Furthermore, reduction in the antioxidant property of peptides following iron complexing indicates iron chelation. Our results suggest that whey protein derived peptide-iron complexes can be used as a potential alternative for chemical iron fortificants for food products and also as iron supplements.
